item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["297b0f523028433cdf93"],"operation":"Report an allocation failure during xmlXIncludeProcessNode through xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc).","condition":"The document-URL copy in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot fails after XInclude-context creation.","capability":"The existing check can observe XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through xinc->errNo or another valid existing failure indication.","consequence":"If the failure is unreported to the check, xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns allocation-failure reporting, not structured-callback configuration."},{"member_ids":["3ba390c0559bc64579bd"],"operation":"Configure an xmlXIncludeCtxt with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler before xmlXIncludeProcessNode.","condition":"Input exercises XInclude, included-document parsing, or XPointer errors.","capability":"Deliver errors to the context-local structured callback with its supplied data.","consequence":"If the handler is unset, the context-local structured error route cannot be exercised.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns callback configuration, not allocation-failure reporting."}]}
